Item.Description: Refrigerated - A container which is used to transport refrigerated cargo.
Tank - A type of vessel used to transport liquid cargo.
Mafi - A type of wheeled trailer onto which cargo is strapped for transport on a vessel.
Open Top - A container with no hard top, used to transport cargo that would not normally fit inside a conventional container.
Flat Rack - Cargo secured onto a flat base, for ease of loading and discharge.
General Purpose (Vented) - A ventilated container used to transport cargo
General Purpose (Non-Vented) - A non-ventilated container used to transport cargo.
